columns.title: How the keys work
items: A key is author plus year; a letter follows when one author has several items in a year (2026a, 2026b).
Letters follow first citation, a team convention that differs from the title order strict APA 7 requires.
Keys 2025a and 2026b are kept from Sections 2–3; their releases are dated 30 Oct 2024 and 8 Oct 2025.
Undated pages use n.d. with a letter; 14 entries are marked Retrieved because the pages change over time.
One Report 2025 pages are the printed ones; the PDF file runs four to six pages ahead.
The 2020 and 2021 annual report entries cite PDF pages.

columns.title: How the counts were made
columns.text: The counts are the team's tally, by author, of the 76 entries in the Chapters 4 to 6 reference list. Press releases carried on a wire service are counted under their author, Central Pattana. Sections 2–3 keep their own reference list, so sources cited only there (for example Inside Retail Asia, 2026, and the Central Retail, S&P Yearbook and April 2026 CPN releases that B6 cites) are not counted here.

notes: Backup slide, not presented. The Chapters 4 to 6 list has 76 entries. By author: 40 from Central Pattana and its investor relations site, 7 from Central Group and The1 Central Limited, 4 official or legal texts, 8 from advisers, raters and research firms, and 17 news items.
